## Problem / 问题

What happened, and what did you expect? / 实际发生了什么，预期是什么？

## Reproduce / 复现

Provide minimal commands or code, source commit/version, Python/OS, and replay/live mode. / 提供最小命令或代码、源码版本、Python／系统与回放／真实模式。

## Evidence / 证据

Attach sanitized errors, relevant decision reasons, and artifacts. State the output directory's frozen identity and whether this is a resume. / 提供脱敏错误、决策原因与相关产物，注明冻结身份及是否续跑。

Remove API keys, private endpoints, and private data before sharing. / 分享前删除 API 凭据、私有端点与私有数据。

## Checks / 检查

Which checks ran? Which external dependencies are absent? / 执行了哪些检查，缺少哪些外部依赖？
